title: Hope vs. Hate: Understanding User Interactions with LGBTQ+ News Content in Mainstream US News Media through the Lens of Hope Speech

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Classifying user comments on mainstream US news YouTube videos to detect positive 'hope speech' versus negative, hostile, or discriminatory content directed at the LGBTQ+ community.

Analyzing subjective differences in how Republican, Democrat, and Independent annotators label LGBTQ+ content, and conducting noise audits to evaluate whether zero-shot and fine-tuned LLMs disproportionately align with the labels of specific political affiliations.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
